scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Oh!! You are a stranger!
I'm Ichack, the first adventurer that arrived here in El Dicastes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
哦！來了一位外地人！
我叫伊查克，是第一個抵達埃爾迪卡特斯的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
There was someone in the expedition team claiming that he was the first, but it WAS me. That's right.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
探險隊裡有人說自己才是第一個來的，可明明就是我！
沒錯，就是我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
That's why I will provide a service to guide adventurers from Midgard.
What would you like to know?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
所以，我來給米德加爾特的冒險者們當嚮導。
你想了解什麼？

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Ah~ That's a beautiful building.
It's said they discuss important things...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
啊~那座建築可漂亮了。
聽說他們會在裡面商議大事...

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Please make sure you signed in at the {0}, otherwise you'll get in trouble.
Go directly north from here and you can't miss it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
一定要先到{0}登記，否則會惹上麻煩。
從這裡一直往北走就能看到。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
The Sapha tribe is so weird. How can they sleep in there?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
薩法族真奇怪。那種地方怎麼睡得著？

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
You don't understand?
You won't believe me until you see it! Go see it for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
聽不明白？
不親眼看看，你肯定不信！
自己去瞧瞧吧！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
The residential area is divided into 2 areas.
The {0} is around 7 o'clock, and the 
{1} is around 1 o'clock.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
居住區分為兩個區域。
{0}在7點鐘方向，{1}在1點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Because of the dangers here, we need better security...
Have you ever been to the 
{0}? The training guards seem to never sleep!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
這兒危險重重，警備可得加強...
你去過{0}嗎？
那裡的衛兵好像不眠不休地訓練！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
This is one of the most important reasons why they live here.
If you go to the {0}, you can see the recently refined Bradium.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
這是他們住在這裡最重要的原因之一。
去{0}的話，就能看到剛精煉好的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Although I arrived here as the first adventurer, the owner of the pub was the first person here.
{0} is located underground in the lower residential area.
He might have some valuable information for you.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
雖然我是第一個來到這裡的冒險者，但酒館老闆才是最早來到這裡的人。
{0}位於下層居住區的地下。
他也許能告訴你一些有價值的情報。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
The {0} don't seem to have a good relationship with the Sapha like we do.
Perhaps it's because trading is involved.
Poor cats. They must be shivering from the cold out there.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
{0}和薩法族的交情，好像沒我們這麼好。
也許是做生意的緣故吧。
可憐的貓咪，待在外頭一定凍得直哆嗦。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
You can find their caravan just outside the gates.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
你可以在大門外找到他們的商隊。
